title: Voc Eval in Cantor Dorm, Two Weeks of Butt-Heads, & The Hall Pass Prison
description: Arriving at Cantor Dorm on a Sunday in March 2007, twenty-one-year-old Katie and Nate endure a creepy first roommate, nasty cafeteria rations, and a two-week Vocational Evaluation where they have to prove they know how to make a bed and do laundry, butt heads with evaluators who demand they split up to 'prove social skills,' and despise begging for Hall Passes just to ride the CATS bus or visit ValueMart.
